name: Albania

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 2363314 inhabitants, recorded as 2.363 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.
Opening estimate, produced with no source and no research. It exists to be falsified, not to be used as data.

Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained. The University of Arts in Tirana, the country's only public higher arts institution, offers within its Faculty of Scenic Art only the programmes Acting, Directing, Scenography and Choreography. No puppetry stream. Upper bound raised from 0 to 1, the detailed acting curriculum not having been read. Estimate.

DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.
